brief.label: BRIEF
brief.title: We meet, we listen, we scope.
brief.desc: 30-min call. You explain the problem, we explain how we'd build it. If there's a fit, we send a fixed-scope proposal.

design.label: DESIGN
design.title: Prototype before we commit.
design.desc: We design the agent flow, the surfaces, the data model, the evals. You get a clickable prototype and a build plan before any code is written.

build.label: BUILD
build.title: You stay in the loop.
build.desc: You see working software early and often. Loom demos, fast deploys, code reviews. You watch the build happen, not just the result.

operate.label: OPERATE
operate.title: Hand off, or stay on.
operate.desc: We can hand the codebase to your team with full docs and runbooks. Or we keep operating it on a monthly retainer. Your call.
